comment: Fork blocks for the live-v2 fork tests (MoneyForward, DiamondMigrationForkE2E, PostDeployMigrationFork). The v2 vaults were paused on 2026-07-23 and then evacuated, so replaying against head asserts preconditions that no longer exist on chain: paused() is now true and the old-vault buffer is 0. These are the last blocks before ANY v2 pause on each chain, so the whole pre-migration world is intact at them.
